deploy.command: if ! command -v wrangler >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Cloudflare Wrangler is not installed'; exit 127; fi; if [[ -z "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-}" || -z "${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-}" ]]; then echo 'Cloudflare credentials are not configured'; exit 126; fi; if [[ ! -f ./app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ]]; then echo 'RMM APK missing; build must succeed before deployment'; exit 125; fi; mkdir -p ./cloudflare-deploy; cp -f ./app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ./cloudflare-deploy/app-debug.apk; wrangler pages deploy ./cloudflare-deploy --project-name rss-money-manager --commit-dirty=true
